correspondence.excerpt: Evaluation is not Validation unless its profile is a validation profile.
Evaluation is not Conformance determination.
Evaluation output is not an authority decision.
This candidate defines Evaluation semantics only. It neither performs an evaluation nor determines conformance or admission.
The application of one exact evaluation profile to one exact subject and input state, collecting every declared check outcome and causal dependency.
scope:evaluation-definition
A claim that the subject conforms.
A human admission or acceptance decision.
An effectful execution not explicitly included in the profile.
An Artifact Type evaluation records schema and semantic-reference checks.
A blocked source dependency makes dependent checks NOT_EVALUABLE, not absent or PASS.
CML-07 uses collect-all evaluations to expose all schema, reference, projection, and dependency outcomes before the one configured owner boundary.
/home/vrondelli/projects/CyberAlchemy-lab
An Evaluation runs a declared set of checks against exact inputs and records every result, including the checks that could not yet be evaluated.
The profile, subject, and inputs are exact and current.
Dependent checks are recorded as NOT_EVALUABLE rather than omitted.
An evaluation result remains inside the profile's coverage.
evaluate(P@digest, S@digest, I@digest) -> O = {(check_id, PASS|FAIL|NOT_EVALUABLE, evidence_refs, blockers)}
; O =/=> admitted(S).
An Evaluation applies a version-exact profile P to a version-exact subject S and input state I, yielding a complete outcome set O with causal blockers preserved.
Evaluation is an evidence-producing process; its outcomes do not exceed P's declared coverage
or create authority.
The exact evaluation profile.
P
The exact subject evaluated.
S
The collect-all set of declared check outcomes.
O
Every declared check has an outcome.
Every NOT_EVALUABLE outcome names its causal blocker.
The evaluation identifies exact profile and subject digests.

unresolved_notes: Current C29 Definition,C13 exact admitted evaluation-profile record,retained candidate source bodies and candidate formal translation have distinct admission and fidelity boundaries.
EvaluationRun denotes a declared profile application and outcome record;actual execution,evidence production and check correctness need separate support.
Exact current profile,subject,input state and digest equality are candidate declared maps,not authenticated currentness or accepted hash/identity denotations.

Exactly one included outcome per declared check is the proposed collect-all set interpretation;no source literal current Check,Outcome,InputState,Profile or CausalBlocker Definition identity is invented.
Declared profile coverage constrains selected outcomes;coverage completeness and check adequacy remain independent actual questions.
PASS,FAIL and NOT_EVALUABLE are pairwise distinct declared status values;PASS is not conformance,admission,authority or evidence truth.
Evidence collections may be empty in this source-level fragment;the current carrier requires nonempty evidence_refs and therefore needs a separate partial correspondence decision.
A NOT_EVALUABLE outcome must include a nonempty declared causal blocker;causal labels do not establish actual cause or adequate dependency provenance.

A declared failed or NOT_EVALUABLE prerequisite makes its dependent outcome NOT_EVALUABLE with that upstream check retained;PASS does not force dependent PASS. Profile blocked_by descriptions are not automatically executable Check identities.
No dependency acyclicity axiom is imported;cycles with declared PASS labels can satisfy this record fragment without establishing valid execution or accepted joint closure.

Validation requires a validation profile,conformance determination and authority-decision roles stay excluded,and explicit profile effect inclusion is only a necessary declaration,not execution authority.

Current C70 direct carrier admits result strings beyond the three source values and does not enforce exact digests,unique check IDs,collect-all coverage or causal blocker resolution. Shape/projection and accepted owner/consumer correspondence remain separate.
